hed: The Dam Is Quiet. The Trout Will Eat.
deck: Table Rock 911.96 ft. 20 cfs through the dam at 09:00 CT. Taneycomo still eats a pink worm if the generators give you a window.

play.title: Streamer on the generate.
play.body: When SWPA spins it, Taneycomo becomes a small river. A dark wooly bugger in the seams.

season.name: Fall turnover
season.why: The lake turns over and the fish don't read the same book they did in August. Crankbaits get good again. Trout streamers get good. This is the season Branson locals wait for.
tips: Windblown banks and shad-colored cranks, 8–18 feet.
Walleye on the same gravel they used all summer, just shallower.
Taneycomo: streamers and wooly buggers when they generate. Hoppers until the first frost.
A jacket in the boat. Dawn is cold before the strip is.

tomorrow: Tomorrow we print a new USACE level, a new play, and whether the dam spun overnight. Open it before you drive. The water will have moved.
weekGraf: Table Rock held near 911.96 ft all week, a hair under full pool (915). Live USACE reading 09:00 CT: 911.96 ft, 20 cfs through the dam. Ramps are still in. Shallow coves feel a falling pool first.

now.temp: Verify at the ramp — we do not invent dawn temps
now.clarity: Clear near the dam; arms can stain. Verify locally.

body: Table Rock sits at 911.96 ft this morning — a live USACE number, not a guess. Full pool is 915. Heat and a falling or hanging pool put bass on main-lake points, gravel, brush, and the first good humps in 15 to 35 feet. If you don't have electronics, you are guessing at bait.

Generation at the dam right now is 20 cfs (turbine 20). Overnight it backed off to about 20; the afternoon peak on this sheet hit 20. That pattern — quiet early, lean on it later — is the late-summer White River book.
The lake turns over and the fish don't read the same book they did in August. Crankbaits get good again. Trout streamers get good. This is the season Branson locals wait for.

taneycomo.dek: Cold tailwater · generation is the whole game

now.temp: Tailwater cold (typically ~50–54°F). Verify at the bank.
now.generation: ~20 cfs at 09:00 CT (USACE live). Call SWPA 866-494-1993 before you wad.

body: Below Table Rock Dam this is a trout river that happens to be called a lake. The water comes out of the bottom cold and gin-clear. The generators decide whether you wade or drift.

Last printed reading: 20 cfs at 09:00 CT. We will not invent the next hour. Southwestern Power keeps the live sheet. The number is 866-494-1993. Call it in the parking lot. Off or near-off: pink Power Worm, wade, kids. Two-thousand-plus: dock or boat, fish the seams.
Light line — two to six pound. Rainbows are most of the creel. Slot in the upper water: put the 12-to-20-inch rainbows back. Don't horse them in this clarity. Don't wad a rising tailrace.

editor.note: Always-on desk: live USACE Little Rock gage (tabrock.htm) plus seasonal playbook. No Mac scout this morning — lid-closed path. Call 866-494-1993 before wading Taneycomo.
